_comment: Pi project settings — overrides ~/.pi/settings.json for this project. Remove any key you want to inherit from global settings. Delete this file if you have no project-specific overrides.

model._comment: Override the LLM model for this project. Options depend on which providers are configured. Examples: 'anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6', 'openai:gpt-4o', 'google:gemini-2.5-pro'. Remove this key to use the global default.
model.name: anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6

tools._comment: Tool permissions for this project. 'allow' skips confirmation, 'deny' blocks, 'ask' prompts (default for most tools). Only configure tools that need project-specific behavior.

compaction._comment: Context compaction behavior. 'auto' triggers when approaching token limit. 'manual' requires /compact command. 'off' disables compaction.

memory._comment: Pi-memory extension config. PI_MEMORY_DIR controls where memory files are stored. Default: ~/.pi/agent/memory/. Set to a project-relative path to keep memory inside the project repo (useful for team-shared memory).
